breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The user's prompt contained contradictory instructions: to use the exact polar moment of inertia `J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32` (implying a thick-walled analysis) and also to use the `mean-area shear-flow relation` (a thin-walled approximation). The ground truth correctly resolved this by removing the mention of the thin-walled tube approximation. The agent failed to fix this and explicitly included the incorrect instruction: "Model the shaft as a thin-walled closed tube using the mean-area shear-flow relation."
